front.title: Registry Lock Extension for the Extensible Provisioning Protocol (EPP)

abstract.t:
This document describes an Extensible Provisioning Protocol (EPP) extension for setting and managing a registry lock on a domain object.
About This Document
This note is to be removed before publishing as an RFC.
Status information for this document may be found at https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-skoglund-epp-registry-lock/.
Source for this draft and an issue tracker can be found at https://github.com/EricIO/draft-regext-epp-registry-lock.
